project_info.theme: World Cup party setup challenge with U-Point reward

main_subject.detail: A mobile-social challenge poster with the Techcombank logo at top right. Large headline says 'CHI CON 3 NGAY THAM GIA THU THACH SET UP BAN TIEC WORLD CUP NGAY'. A large vertical smartphone with a red screen frame holds a polaroid-style social post card. The post text reads 'TOI MUON NHAN 500 NGHIN U-POINT DE NANG CAP BAN TIEC WORLD CUP' above a photo of four young fans in red, blue, and white football shirts cheering around a living-room party table filled with pizza and snacks. Red U-point coin icons float around the phone. Bottom-left slogan reads 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY'.
main_subject.style: Clean social-campaign poster with smartphone-frame centerpiece, UGC-photo proof, and soft lifestyle excitement
